name: smoke_allseed_depth1_superconformal
notes: All-seed depth=1 smoke under judge ②a (the superconformal R-charge policy). Identical structure to smoke.json but verifier.r_charge_policy='superconformal': every claim carries THE superconformal (a-maximized) R, and a-max audits it before the duality comparison. Positives are regenerated with the superconformal R substituted into both sides (rational for dp0/f0/c3_z2z2, irrational for dp1/dp2/spp). Requires the optional [amax] extra (sympy). Smoke mode: n_per_cell=1, allow_incomplete_cells=true.
